newsitem.title: USA: Equimed says to delay 10K filing.
newsitem.headline: Equimed says to delay 10K filing.

text.p: EquiMed Inc said Tuesday it would not file its annual report with the Securities and Exchange Commission on the required filing date of April 15, 1997.
The company said the previously reported reason for the delay is its inability to gain access to certain financial records relating to its ophthalmology business, which was sold to another company.
An Equimed spokesman said it sold the business to Physicians Resource Group.

Equimed said it has entered into a consent order with the purchaser in which the purchaser would deliver the necessary records. The company said it agreed in the consent order to file the annual report as soon as possible.
